decisions.reason: As a coolant-management extension squarely within the firm's existing engineering and service knowledge, its continued presence through 2024 suggests the firm can learn from early adoption and improve it with its in-house R&D.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge builds directly on the firm's established filtration and process-media capabilities, so absorptive capacity is high and the 2023-2024 market presence supports continued commercialization.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is closely related to the firm's conveying and automation base, and a large broad-line German machinery firm would typically retain such an adjacent product when early market feedback has not forced withdrawal.

The hinged belt chip conveyor fits the firm's modular material-flow portfolio and can be refined using existing mechanical design, production and service competences, making retention the more likely 2025 decision.
